name: Lithium iron phosphate (LFP)
description: Flat-voltage phosphate cathode with relatively low-cost iron chemistry.

name: Lithium cobalt oxide (LCO)
description: Layered cathode with limited reversible capacity within conventional voltage windows.

name: Lithium manganese oxide (LMO)
description: Spinel oxide cathode; default capacity is a representative illustrative input.

name: Lithium nickel manganese cobalt oxide (NMC111)
description: Equimolar Ni-Mn-Co layered cathode; operating properties depend on voltage window.

name: Graphite
description: Capacity calculated on the mass of unlithiated C6 graphite host.

name: Lithium titanate (LTO)
description: Three lithium ions insert per starting LTO formula unit.
